descriptions.inProgress: I met with #p2140002#.  He noticed right away that my emotions had been frozen and told me to buy his #bpotion#k if I want to thaw out my emotions.  He says it's not cheap but it will definitely work.  However, there's just one side effect to the potion...
descriptions.completed: I drank #p2140002#'s potion.  Due to the side effect, all of my HP and MP were drained, making me temporarily unavailable for combat, but I think I found my emotions back.  I should try going past the Road of Regrets now.
